birth.stop: Zhongdu, birth in a Mongol-held city

stops.stop: The Bay of Naples, the Battle of the Counts
stops.date_confidence: attested to 23 June in the battle historiography; Bar Sauma's own account renders it as 24 June, the feast of Saint John, and two research lenses split on this. Place corrected: the engagement is normally set in the Bay of Naples with the Angevin fleet beached near Castellammare di Stabia, not the Bay of Sorrento. Charles II was an Aragonese prisoner and not in command; the Angevin fleet was led by Reynald Quarrel of Avella under Narjot de Toucy against Roger of Lauria.
